title: Import Appendix MM-B NPC stat blocks
description:
﻿Implement D&D SRD 5.1 Appendix MM-B NPC stat-block import coverage.

Problem:
Appendix MM-B contains NPC stat blocks such as Bandit Captain and Berserker. These were previously omitted, but that omission is a mistake for Loreweaver gameplay because NPC stat blocks are encounter-usable stat blocks and should be queryable like other combatants.

Scope:
- Import Appendix MM-B Nonplayer Characters from the vendored SRD 5.1 PDF.
- Decide the minimal schema implementation path during coding:
  - preferred: emit them as creature records with an npc/category/source flag if the current creature schema can support that cleanly;
  - otherwise add a dedicated npc/stat-block kind if required by typed boundaries.
- Preserve stat-block fields: name, size, type/subtype, alignment, armor class, hit points, speed, ability scores, challenge rating when present, actions, traits, reactions, spellcasting sections, and source provenance.
- Ensure NPC records do not pollute the existing exact 296 creature baseline for Monsters + Appendix MM-A unless the policy intentionally expands that baseline.

Acceptance criteria:
- Appendix MM-B NPC stat blocks are represented in the rules pack.
- Tests cover representative NPCs, including Bandit Captain and Berserker.
- Existing creature baseline for Monsters + Appendix MM-A remains meaningful; if NPCs are emitted as creature records, tests distinguish monster-creature coverage from NPC coverage.
- No duplicate key collisions with existing creature records.
- npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exits 0.
- npm run audit:rules-pack -- packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1 reports no new suspicious findings or only documented reviewed findings.
- npm run check, npm run typecheck, and npm test pass.
- Do not treat this as a policy-decision-only bead; implement the import.
notes: Imported Appendix MM-B (21 NPC stat blocks) under the creature kind with a data.category='npc' discriminator. Monster records unchanged (no category field); creature kind 296->317. New EXPECTED_SRD_5_1_NPC_NAMES exact-coverage gate + NpcCoverageError. verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exits 0; audit 0 suspicious.
close_reason: Imported Appendix MM-B (21 NPC stat blocks) as creature records with data.category='npc'. PR #148. verify exits 0; check/typecheck/test pass.
